pulses.name: ClickFix Campaigns Targeting Windows and macOS
pulses.description: Insikt Group identified five distinct clusters using the ClickFix social engineering technique for initial access. These clusters impersonate various services like Intuit QuickBooks and Booking.com, demonstrating operational variance but similar core techniques.
